description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to support displaced populations impacted by the hostilities at the Lebanon-Israel border. This project will be implemented in the South, Nabatiyeh, and Mount Lebanon Governorates, and will include activities such as providing protection cash assistance, shelter cash assistance, and increased access to secondary and tertiary healthcare. Under the Protection sector, this project will assist 3,892 people, including 1,188 women, 1,790 children, and 397 persons with disabilities. Under the Multi-Purpose Cash sector, this project will assist 3,350 people, including 746 women, 1,943 children, and 436 persons with disabilities. Under the Shelter and Non-Food Items sector, this project will assist 4,784 people, including 1,196 women, 2,392 children, and 1,660 persons with disabilities. Lastly, under the Health sector this project will assist 1,700 people including 1,190 women, and 420 children.
